title: New usage analytics and updated spend controls for enterprises
summary: OpenAI introduces new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, helping organizations manage costs and scale AI with confidence.
body: OpenAI introduces new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, helping organizations manage costs and scale AI with confidence.
summaryZh: OpenAI为ChatGPT Enterprise引入了全新的使用分析功能和更新的支出控制机制，使组织能够更精确地监控成本、优化资源配置并放心地进行大模型规模化部署。原始信息显示：OpenAI introduces new spend controls and usage analytics for ChatGPT Enterprise, helping organizations manage costs and scale AI with confidence.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“New usage analytics and updated spend controls for enterprises”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI为其企业版ChatGPT推出了新的用例分析和支出控制功能，帮助企业更好地管理AI成本与规模化落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
